title: Pay domestic minimum tax (large multinational groups)
what: An entity with a Domestic Top-up Tax Amount for a fiscal year pays domestic minimum tax.

laws.title: Taxation (Multinational—Global and Domestic Minimum Tax) Act 2024

sources.title: Taxation (Multinational—Global and Domestic Minimum Tax) Act 2024
sources.quote: 8 Liability to tax—Australian DMT tax (1) Tax is payable by an Entity for a Fiscal Year if it has one or more Domestic Top-up Tax Amounts for the Fiscal Year.
